title: Heat a meal
start_push: First, take your meal out of the fridge or freezer. That's all for now.

steps.text: Put your food on a microwave-safe dish

substeps.text: Look on the bottom for "microwave safe"
No metal, foil, or gold or silver trim
No takeout boxes, yogurt or butter tubs, or foam
Not sure? Take a photo and ask, or use a plate you know is safe

steps.check_question: Did you use a microwave-safe dish?

steps.text: Cover it loosely so steam can get out

substeps.text: Use a microwave-safe lid, paper towel or wax paper
Leave a small gap for steam
Don't let plastic wrap touch the food

steps.text: Put it in the middle and close the door

substeps.text: Put the dish in the middle
Close the door until it clicks

steps.text: Set the time and press Start

substeps.text: Read the time on the package. No package? Use the time on your meal card
Press the numbers
Press Start

steps.text: Halfway through, stir or turn the food

substeps.text: When the time is half done, press Stop
Use oven mitts. The dish may be hot
Stir or turn the food
Close the door and press Start

steps.text: When it beeps, let it sit for a few minutes

substeps.text: Leave it in, or take it out with oven mitts
Wait a few minutes, or the time on the package

steps.text: Check it's hot all the way through

substeps.text: Stir it
Look for steam in the middle
Not hot in the middle? Heat it a little more
Have a food thermometer? It should say 165°F

steps.check_question: Was it hot all the way through?
